judgment.rationale: Maintainer-reproduced interference affects several Windows hold-triggered features.
evidence: Win+V and Win+H fail with Hold Windows key enabled.
Find My Mouse is also affected.
Disabling the setting removes the issue.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a pass-through design for bare Win-key holds.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt covers bare Win-key ownership.

proposed_fixes.title: Stop intercepting bare Win-key holds used by Windows
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Shortcut Guide activates and takes foreground/input ownership before Windows completes its own hold gesture.
plan: Trace ShortcutGuideActivationPolicy and OverlayWindow input ownership.
Require a Guide-specific chord or pass through once a non-Guide Windows chord is detected.
Add Win+V, Win+H, and pointer-feature tests.
verification: With default settings, hold Win through Win+V and Win+H and confirm built-in UI remains usable.

confidence.rationale: Multiple independent Windows features reproduce the same shared hold-path failure.

issue_context.summary: Shortcut Guide's default bare-Win hold interferes with Windows 11 features that also use Win-key hold timing.
known_information: Affected features include Clipboard History, Voice typing, and Find My Mouse.
Disabling Hold Windows key avoids the problem.
Discussion identifies foreground takeover as the likely mechanism.
inferences: Shortcut Guide cannot safely own the bare hold gesture.
Modifier-qualified activation or early pass-through is safer than feature-specific exceptions.
issue_context.analysis: The shared trigger across multiple built-in features makes ownership, not Clipboard History, the correct fix boundary.
initial_investigation: Relevant areas are ShortcutGuideActivationPolicy.cs, OverlayWindow.xaml.cs, and ActivationTests.
No linked PR or fork fix exists.

design.root_cause: The bare Windows-key hold timer takes foreground/input ownership before Windows-owned gestures complete.
evidence: Observed: disabling the hold setting fixes them.
Inferred: overlay ownership is the shared mechanism.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Bare Win hold can activate after a timeout.
implementation_steps.change: Cancel or pass through bare holds when a non-Guide Windows chord is observed; activate only for the configured Guide trigger.
implementation_steps.code_block:
if (IsBareWindowsHold && IsWindowsOwnedChordObserved) return PassThrough;
+if (IsConfiguredGuideChord(input)) return Activate;
tests: Policy tests for Win+V, Win+H, and genuine Guide activation.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Overlay can take foreground/input during a Windows shortcut.
implementation_steps.change: Take ownership only after policy approval and release it immediately on pass-through.
edge_cases: Clean up hooks on unexpected close.
tests: Manual UI test for built-in dialogs after Win release.

verify: Build Shortcut Guide and run ActivationTests.
Test Win+V, Win+H, and Find My Mouse on Windows 11 25H2 with default settings.
Confirm normal Shortcut Guide activation remains functional.
risks: Windows behavior varies by OS build.
alternatives: Special-case Win+V/Win+H; rejected because future hold gestures remain vulnerable.
Increase timeout; rejected because timing remains unreliable.
